correctness.rationale: For n>=6, the Johnson three-subset adjacency identity A_1^2=3(n-3)I+(n-2)A_1+4A_2 and the inclusion-filtration spectrum produce all three nontrivial eigenvalues of invariant stochastic kernels. Full permutation averaging cannot worsen SLEM. On the resulting compact two-simplex, the displayed strictly positive dual multipliers certify the minimax branches for n=6..9 and 10..12; the single-mode bound certifies n>=13. Feasible rational weight formulas attain each bound. Averaging nonnegative entries makes suppression of all one-swaps for n>=10 and of diagonal holds for n>=13 valid for every unrestricted optimizer, without claiming unrestricted uniqueness. Independent exact rational checks at all branch transitions and 400 adjacency-square entries at n=6 matched formulas.
